name: mopm-site
description: The mopm.dev web site: prerendered pages, a small read-only client of the registry API, and the tutorial's runner over the e2b SDK (its one runtime dependency, bundled for the tutorial pages only)

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('build',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && node build/tools/tools/build.js
